name: MBZUAI — MS Machine Learning / AI Safety
org: Mohamed bin Zayed University of AI
notes: Primary funded MS target. Abu Dhabi. Fully funded (tuition + stipend). Faculty targets: Umang Bhatt (explainability), Nils Lukas (ML security). Draft inquiry email prepared — not yet sent. CGPA meets floor (~3.0/4.0 equiv) but not comfortably. Action: send faculty cold emails now, then apply when portal opens.

name: IIT Madras — Web-Enabled MTech in AI
notes: No GATE required. Immediately accessible as existing IITM BS student. Most accessible MTech path. Low cost. Check current application cycle and whether BS completion is required first.

name: KAUST — MS Computer Science (AI/ML)
notes: Portal opens Sep 28 2026. Fully funded: $20k/yr stipend + housing + health + travel. GPA risk: 7.5 CGPA = ~3.0/4.0, most admits above 3.3. Age question emailed Aug 27 2026 — no reply yet. No age cap found on current site. English test mandatory. GRE recommended given GPA. Get written age confirmation before investing effort in SOP.

name: IIT Bombay — MTech AI (via GATE)
notes: Fallback if international programs don't materialize. GATE exam required — active prep decision needed. Strong domestic credential.

name: Fulbright-Nehru Scholarship
notes: India-specific cycle. Covers US grad study. Check eligibility and current deadline — may have passed for 2026 cycle.

name: Ireland — PhD / Research Scholarship
notes: Critical Skills Employment Permit route for longer-term residency. Research scholarship deadline ~October. Longer-term plan — not immediate priority.

name: EMAI — Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in AI
notes: Fully funded Erasmus Mundus scholarship: tuition waived + €1,400/month stipend + travel. 2-year joint degree across 4 European universities (Spain, Italy, Netherlands, Slovenia). Scholarship application period 1: Nov 15 – Dec 20 2026. Period 2 (tuition waiver only): until Mar 18 2027. Requires: transcripts, CV, motivation letter, English proof (IELTS/TOEFL), 2 reference letters, short intro video. Check 2027 intake dates — current listing may be for 2026 entry. Very strong fit given fully funded + Europe mobility + no single-country tuition.

name: Erasmus Mundus 2027 — new AI cohorts
notes: 37 new Erasmus Mundus programmes announced July 2026, including several with AI/data/compute focus. Applications expected to open autumn 2026, programs start Sep 2027. Fully funded: tuition waived + €1,400/month + travel. Check catalogue for new AI-specific programs. Apply to 2-3 programs simultaneously — applications are per-program, not centralised.

name: TU Darmstadt — MSc AI & ML
notes: Germany public university — zero tuition (Hesse state, no non-EU surcharge). Only semester contribution ~€300. English-taught. 4 semesters. Part of Hessian AI Center. DAAD-listed. Winter intake. Requirements: relevant BSc, math/CS foundation. APS certification required for Indian students (allow 8-12 weeks). Solid research connections to industry. Budget: ~€12-15k/year living.

name: RWTH Aachen — MSc Data Science (AI track)
notes: Zero tuition — North Rhine-Westphalia state, no non-EU surcharge. Semester fee ~€300. English-taught. Strong industry ties (Mercedes, Ford labs nearby). Winter and summer intakes. Requires: relevant BSc, math/CS credits. APS certification required. Budget: ~€12-15k/year. Good option if MBZUAI/Erasmus Mundus don't work out.

name: Saarland University — MSc Data Science & AI
notes: Zero tuition. Semester fee ~€300. English-taught. Home of DFKI (German Research Center for AI) — direct research access. C1 English required (IELTS equivalent) — medium-of-instruction certificate NOT accepted. Winter and summer intakes. APS certification required for Indian students. Budget: ~€10-12k/year (Saarbrücken is cheaper than Munich/Berlin).

name: Saarland / IMPRS-CS — PhD in CS/AI
notes: International Max Planck Research School for Computer Science. Fully funded PhD: salary ~€2,000-2,500/month (TVöD). No tuition. Saarbrücken campus. Competitive but skips the MS step entirely. Worth tracking if research output materialises. Nov deadline typical. Requires strong research background or publications.

name: TU Berlin — MSc Computer Science (AI focus)
notes: Zero tuition — Berlin state, no non-EU surcharge. Semester fee ~€350. English-taught programs available. Berlin startup ecosystem (Aleph Alpha, deeptech hubs). Winter intake. APS certification required. Budget: ~€14-16k/year (Berlin cost of living rising). AI specialisation within general CS MSc.

name: Chevening + UK University MSc AI
notes: Chevening covers tuition + stipend for 1-year UK MSc. Strong fit given work experience (explicitly valued, no age cap). Can target UCL, Edinburgh, Imperial, Southampton AI programs. Apply Chevening first, then identify specific program. This doubles as a grad program AND a fellowship — highest leverage application in the pipeline.
